facts.text: Long before European settlers, the Lenni Lenape built an agricultural society around 1000 AD in the area that is now Strathmore.
Levitt & Sons began building Strathmore in 1961, creating a higher‑end planned community called Strathmore at Matawan that spans 1.97 sq mi along Raritan Bay.
Because of its Raritan Bay location, Strathmore enjoys milder weather than inland areas, with coastal breezes keeping extremes in check.
In May 1778, a skirmish broke out at Burrowes Mansion, the home of grain merchant John “Corn King” Burrowes Jr., highlighting the area’s agricultural ties to the Revolutionary War.
